description: Lists the Instagram post templates (1080 x 1350) with slug, name, family and whether they need your own imagery. Each template is a single HTML file that can be rebuilt and exported as an image or a video. Pass query to search by name or purpose, for example 'quote' or 'statistic'. Use it to pick a slug for get_post.

family.description: Family to filter by (optional): 'klar' are calm informational posts, 'editorial' lives on the image and a serif face.

query.description: Search term (optional). Every word must appear in the slug, name, purpose or family. Can be combined with family.

name: list_posts
title: List post templates
